name: DCA Schmoozies! (Hollywood Land) Mango-Banana Smoothie vs. Mickey Shake (Check Citrus)
whyItWorks: Blended ripe banana and mango with low-fat yogurt provides soluble fiber and potassium on a hot afternoon in Hollywood Land.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Mango-Banana Smoothie (verify at the window that no orange/lemon juice base is used, and take a lactase tablet for the yogurt) or a warm Mickey Waffle when offered.
watchOuts: Skip Strawberry-Banana if strawberry seeds bother you, and avoid all Lemonade slushies (citrus trigger)
